definitions: A person who excels at a particular sport or other activity.
A playing card with a single spot on it, ranking as the highest card in its suit in most card games.
A point scored by a direct hit with a serve, especially in tennis, that an opponent fails to return.
examples: He's an ace on the tennis court.
She drew the ace of spades.
The server hit an ace to win the game.
They needed just one ace to complete the set.
